notes.title: Blastworld Grand Opening + Competition to win VR headsets!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35839712/30d7455cf2bb80e57ed6b0e766b379527477f16e.png

Welcome to the Grand Opening of Blastworld!

The new Overkill game mode is an awesome class-based attackers vs. defenders mode, which brings the total of team-based game modes to 3!

We're trying to build Blastworld into a place where you can find a lot of PvP and PvE content for free! Go check out the game modes today and stay tuned for more updates.



Take part in the competition for a chance to win HTC Vive Pro Eye or HTC Vive Cosmos!

You can either make a video of Blastworld or fight your way to the top in the game!

Check full competition rules here: https://www.hipfirevr.com/competitions/

---

What's included in this version of Blastworld?
- Overkill (Team-based PvP)
- Zombies Royale (PvP, PvE)
- Bomb Defusal (Team-based PvP)
- Capture The Flag (Team-based PvP)

+ Social hub of course. Expect to see a fancier version soon!

Does leaving Early Access mean that the game is finished? No, of course not! We plan to keep bringing you more content, competitions and other activities for in the future too. Even more than before! 

Blastworld is something we wish to see getting a life of its own. Join the Discord server and let us know what you'd like to see in the future!

Good luck and have fun everyone!

notes.title: Zombies Royale Co-op Mode + LIV Support
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35839712/1f2eaa6b434b7953acc1557a65d1db77bfdb088e.jpg

You can now play the Zombies Royale mod against AI with up to 4 people on the survivor side. It's possible to choose the enemy wave difficulty as well from easy, medium and hard. 

Another improvement has been the weapons spawns, which are now more visible and randomized instead of static spawns.

The helicopter rescue at the end has been iterated further too, it will pick you up for 4 randomized locations! Better be quick!

Join us in our Discord server to keep up with the latest news and hang out with other cool VR folks!

Full changelist below:

- Co-op mode (4 players max)
- Native Liv support
- Randomized weapon spawns
- Endgame variations
- Bot difficulty option
- Performance improvements
- Volume options in wrist menu
- Main menu has more stuff in it

notes.title: Jump! New and intuitive way to jump and reach ledges added!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=fWnSl1Pt7so;full][/previewyoutube]

Reach new heights with our innovative jump method. Just throw your arms up quickly and you'll be boosted higher.

Don't let anything stop your parkouring as you jump from rooftop to rooftop!

The new jump is available on the Thumbstick or Arm swinger movement modes.

The update also includes the following smaller things:

- Sound & Haptics for pocketing guns
- Fixed accidentally dropping weapons when climbing
- Enter name when getting to leaderboard
- Activity portal fixed
- Added changelog to the VR menu

See you on the servers!

notes.title: Update: Smooth locomotion, leaderboard and much more!
notes.content:
We heard an outcry from you guys about the lack of smooth / thumbstick locomotion. So we listened!

Major features:

 "Classic" thumbstick locomotion added as a 3rd option beside comfort and arm swinger.
 You can now climb even with weapons in your hand by using the grip buttons. The old style of having empty hands and gripping with triggers still works though for those who prefer it!
 Make it matter with our new Leaderboard! Each match with at least 2 vs. 2 players (equal teams) will give you an increase or a decrease in Skill Points depending how you do. Works only in Skanktown at the moment. Coming up soon is Ranks!


Small stuff:
- Fixed gun / hand positions in Oculus devices.
- Fixed pistol animations

Go try out the new movement tweaks and tell us what you think!
